children: is a military base surrounded by hills. It was originally a simplistic map, but has now since been changed to become very detailed.

is a military base in a forest, surrounded by hill terrain. There is a large gate, which is the entrance to the military base. Around the map, there are multiple wooden houses, a green military tent, two wooden watch towers, a military exercise with tires, and a shooting range can be seen. A stone path can be seen, which connects multiple of the buildings. Around the map, multiple barrels, wooden crates, rocks and small grassy hills can be seen.

The path starts and ends at a cave. The enemies will take multiple turns, avoiding various structures seen on the map.

was a military base island. Despite being an island, three sides of the map were surrounded by hilly terrain. Around the map, there were various miscellaneous military buildings, including hangers, administrative buildings and a headquarters. Despite the map's name, there were not too many trees around the map, given its general openness. On the hills, there was an outlook tower that had visual of the entire island and the sea. A road system connected the entire base, with tanks being visible around the map, as well as a paved runway on the only non-hilly part of the map. Next to the runway were several aviation hangers, planes and an air control tower.

The path began at a cave in one of the hills. Initially, the path was grassy, then turned into a military exercise path, with tires being seen on the path. The path then entered the main road system of the island, which took a detour to avoid a tank blocking the road. It then ended at the military base headquarters, with a large vehicle entrance.
was exactly identical to the second version, except with terrain water surrounding the island.

The brown pebble path began at the edge of the military outpost and ended at the far cave. The path twisted around several buildings and natural environment.

was a simplistic map that resembled a camping outpost, with a single watchtower in the middle of the map. There were very few trees around the path. There were some stone mountains scattered around the map, where you can place cliff towers on. The entire map was surrounded by a large green baseplate.

The black path meandered through the "forest" taking two cutbacks.
